newsitem.title: USA: Trans World Airlines Inc Q4 loss widens.
newsitem.headline: Trans World Airlines Inc Q4 loss widens.

text.p: Shr loss $ 5.56 loss $ 0.84
Net loss 258,600 loss 27,800
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: 1996 Q4 loss includes charges to earnings of $85.9 million comprised of non-cash charge of $53.7 million from planned retirement of L-1011 and B-747 fleets; a charge of $5.5 million for overseas employee severance; a non-cash charge of $26.7 million from writedown of carrying value of TWA's New York to Athens route authority; and a charge of $2.4 million from early retirement of debt.
1995 Q4 loss includes gain of $3.5 million.
12 MONTHS
Shr loss $ 7.27 loss $ N/A

Avg shrs 44,190 N/A
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: 1996 year loss includes charges of $85.9 million and extraordinary item of s of $9.8 million.
1995 year loss includes charges of $155.8 million from the company's financial restructuring.
TWA said that due to its 1995 restructuring, comparisons of annual earnings per share are not meaningful.
TWA reported a 1996 yearend cash balance of $181.6 million compared with cash of $304.3 million at 1995 yearend.
1996 Q4 operating expenses totaled $1.035.7 million vs $803.4 million in 1995 Q4.
1996 year operating expenses totaled $3,752.9 million vs $3,291.7 million in 1995 year.
1996 year aircraft fuel and oil expenses totaled $585.2 million vs $458.6 million in 1995 year.
